summary: The Sun's full 7th aspect on the lagna (Sun in the 7th) gives courage, a commanding and sometimes harsh temper, and links fortune to the father's side and to service of authority.
common_outcomes: gains wealth from the father's side; may inherit from the father (Saravali 34.1-7; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII)
service of a ruler or government (Saravali 34.1-7)
rare_outcomes: Aspects on the natal Moon (the Moon treated as a second lagna, BPHS ch. 12): Phaladeepika 18.6-11 gives the Sun's aspect on the Moon as poverty in Aries, Gemini and Capricorn, service in Taurus, eye trouble in Cancer, kingly status in Leo and Virgo, wickedness in Libra, lack of money in Scorpio, arrogance in Sagittarius, respect in Aquarius and sinfulness in Pisces; 18.12-15 give separate results by the Moon's navamsa. Brihat Jataka 19.1-3 gives a parallel list (e.g. Moon in Aries aspected by the Sun: poor).
Mars in the lagna aspected by the Sun (or Saturn) brings wounds and accidents (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).

by_area.personality: Brave, proud and quick-tempered, can be harsh (Saravali 34.1-7).
by_area.finance: Wealth through the father's line (Saravali 34.1-7; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).
by_area.relationships: Can be irritable or severe with women (Saravali 34.1-7).
by_area.family: Father-linked inheritance (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIII).

strengtheners: Saravali 34.8: a planet aspecting a lagna that is its own sign (Leo lagna) gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Two or more planets aspecting the lagna give happiness and wealth (Saravali 34.10-11).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.10-11: a malefic aspecting the lagna is inauspicious unless it owns the sign.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.
lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects the lagna from the 7th house. For Leo lagna this is the lagna lord's own aspect (Saravali 34.8, BPHS 11).

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.1-7
source_views.view: If the Sun aspects the ascendant the native is valorous, irascible with women, cruel, gains wealth from the paternal side and serves the king.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.8
source_views.view: A planet aspecting the ascendant that is its own sign confers happiness, wealth and closeness to the king; otherwise a benefic gives good and a malefic evil results.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.10-11
source_views.view: One benefic aspecting the ascendant is auspicious, a malefic so aspecting is inauspicious; two or more planets aspecting give happiness and wealth.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 2 ch. XIII (Ninth House)
source_views.view: The Sun aspecting the ascendant shows the native may inherit wealth from his father.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) 18.6-11
source_views.view: Results of the Moon in each sign aspected by Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn and the Sun (listed in that order).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (Sanskrit/English, M. D. Neely, wisdomlib) 19.1-3 (via the wisdomlib verse pages)
source_views.view: Moon in each sign aspected by each planet; e.g. Moon in Aries aspected by the Sun: poor.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers p. 78 (Sun as a malefic)
source_views.view: The Sun, a hot planet, tends to limit or destroy the affairs of the house it occupies or aspects.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 2.30-31
source_views.view: Repeats the quarter/half/three-quarter/full scheme and the special strengths of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars; all planets have full aspect strength on the 7th.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

disagreements: Saravali calls the Sun's aspect 'cruel' in tone while Raman stresses the paternal inheritance; both appear in Saravali 34.1-7. Strength scheme: BPHS 26.3, Brihat Jataka 2.13, Jataka Parijata 2.30 and Raman/Frawley give 3rd/10th = 1/4, 5th/9th = 1/2, 4th/8th = 3/4, 7th = full; Saravali 4.32-33 (Santhanam, as scanned) gives half to the 4th/8th and a different (illegible) fraction to the 5th/9th. Phaladeepika 4.9: some hold only the 7th aspect fully effective, others hold the special aspects equally effective. Raman (HPA XIII) and PVR (ch. 10) use only full aspects in practice.
phrasing_guidance: Present as strength, self-assertion and a father-linked inheritance; mention a sharp temper as something to manage. Describe the Sun's aspect as bringing authority, pride or pressure to the house; avoid saying it 'destroys' anything, and weigh its functional role.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it
happiness, wealth and closeness to people in power (planet aspecting its own sign as lagna)

lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 2nd from the 8th house.

summary: The Sun's aspect on the 3rd adds a 'male' planetary influence on siblings: with the Moon alone in the 3rd it indicates younger brothers, and any aspect on the 3rd raises the count of co-born.
common_outcomes: Moon alone in the 3rd aspected by male planets (the Sun is one) indicates younger brothers (BPHS 14.12-13)
planets aspecting the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born counted from its navamsas (Saravali 34.21-24)
rare_outcomes: Mercury in the 3rd aspected by the Sun (a variant reading for Mars in Saravali 34.21-24) harms the native's friends.

by_area.family: Younger brothers indicated when the Moon in the 3rd is aspected by male planets (BPHS 14.12-13); more co-born when the 3rd is aspected (Saravali 34.21-24).

weakeners_or_cancellations: A malefic owning and occupying the 3rd harms co-born (Saravali 34.21-24); the Sun's aspect is malefic by nature.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.
lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 3rd from the 9th house.

summary: The Sun's aspect on the 5th mainly appears in special progeny combinations in Saravali (adoption, unusual circumstances of a child's birth); as a malefic aspect it makes progeny harder.
common_outcomes: a malefic aspect on the 5th gives progeny with difficulty (Saravali 34.27)
rare_outcomes: Mars in the 5th in Saturn's divisions aspected by the Sun: a son adopted after being given up by his parents (Saravali 34.33, after sage Karuna).
Moon in the 5th aspected by or with the Sun: a child through an unmarried girl (Saravali 34.35).
Moon and Saturn in the 5th in Saturn's vargas aspected by the Sun and Venus: a child by a remarried widow (Saravali 34.34).

by_area.family: Progeny with difficulty under malefic aspect (Saravali 34.27).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.27: malefic aspect on the 5th makes progeny difficult.
Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

phrasing_guidance: Describe the Sun's aspect as bringing authority, pride or pressure to the house; avoid saying it 'destroys' anything, and weigh its functional role.

effects: the house is protected and its matters prosper when aspected by its own lord, even if malefics also influence it

summary: Raman's career analyses count the Sun's aspect on the 10th as shaping the kind of work (authority, government, commerce with Mercury); no classical rule names it.
common_outcomes: with Mercury and a strong 9th lord Jupiter aspecting the 10th: a top post in a commercial concern (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)

by_area.career: Aspects of the Sun (and Mars) close to the 10th cusp can decide the nature of work more than a wider Jupiter aspect (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart notes).

strengtheners: Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV: an aspect exact to the 10th cusp weighs more than a wide one.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Frawley: the Sun's heat tends to limit or burn up the matters of the house it aspects.
lagna_or_context_notes: The Sun aspects the 10th from the 4th house.
